description: Get active IBM i jobs information
sql: SELECT JOB_NAME, JOB_USER, JOB_NUMBER, JOB_TYPE, JOB_STATUS, SUBSYSTEM, CPU_TIME, ELAPSED_TIME FROM TABLE(QSYS2.ACTIVE_JOB_INFO()) WHERE (JOB_NAME LIKE '%{{job_name}}%' OR '{{job_name}}' IS NULL) AND (JOB_USER = '{{job_user}}' OR '{{job_user}}' IS NULL) AND (JOB_TYPE = '{{job_type}}' OR '{{job_type}}' IS NULL) ORDER BY CPU_TIME DESC FETCH FIRST {{limit}} ROWS ONLY
